title: Control VAR: a counterfactual based approach to inference in macroeconomics
abstract: arXiv:2510.23762v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A recursive VAR is read as causal whenever the policy is ordered first. I show that this ordering is not sufficient when the policy reacts to the economy it is meant to affect: the impulse response then combines the causal effect with a bias from the common trends that the policy reacts to and a bias specific to the treated unit. I develop the Control VAR (CVAR), which compares the treated unit with untreated controls that share its stochastic trends, and removes the first bias and, under exogeneity with respect to the counterfactual cycle, the second. The method allows repeated, continuous and multiple policies, separates the effect of a single policy change from that of its later values, measures the bias of a VAR without controls through the response of the controls, and bounds the remaining bias. I estimate the weights, derive bootstrap inference, show that the CVAR in changes remains valid when the treated unit has a stochastic

translated_title: Control VAR：一种基于反事实的宏观经济学推断方法
translated_abstract: 当政策变量被排在最前面时，递归VAR（向量自回归模型）通常被解读为因果模型。我证明，当政策对其试图影响的经济做出反应时，这种排序并不充分：此时脉冲响应会将因果效应与两种偏差混合在一起——一种来自政策所响应的共同趋势，另一种则是处理单位特有的偏差。我提出了Control VAR（CVAR）方法，该方法将处理单位与共享其随机趋势的未处理对照单位进行比较，从而消除第一种偏差，并在相对于反事实周期具有外生性的条件下消除第二种偏差。该方法允许重复、连续以及多项政策，能够将单一政策变化的效应与其后续取值的效应分离开来，通过对照单位的响应来度量无控制变量VAR的偏差，并为剩余偏差提供界限。我估计了权重，推导了bootstrap推断，并证明当处理单位具有随机趋势时，以差分形式表示的CVAR仍然有效。
tldr: 提出Control VAR（CVAR）方法，通过将受政策影响的单位与共享相同随机趋势的未处理对照单位进行比较，消除政策对经济做出反应时递归VAR因果推断中的两类偏差，从而实现更可靠的宏观经济政策效应评估。
en_tdlr: This paper develops Control VAR (CVAR), a counterfactual-based method that removes causal-inference biases in macroeconomic policy analysis by comparing treated units with untreated controls that share their stochastic trends.
